rules.rationale: Institutional flow is same-session information released after the market close; the first daily close price executable after availability is the next exchange session close.
The cached fundamental panel does not carry exact release timestamps, so replay treats each observation as available only after that session's close.
Institutional flow is same-session information released after the market close; the first daily close price executable after availability is the next exchange session close.
The signal can depend on same-session close, volume, or derived technical values; it cannot receive the same close as its entry price.
